cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && bash -s <<'SH'

kill $WP 2>/dev/null; wait $WP 2>/dev/null

import json, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts/ringer/environment_narration")
import enforce_report as e
base = "bench/results/environment-narration/t9e-check/latency"
assert json.load(open(base + "/spent.json"))["spent_micro_usd"] <= 100000
for route, reps, turns in (("a", 3, 9), ("c", 4, 6)):
    rows = json.load(open(f"{base}/{route}/rows/rows.json"))
    summary = json.load(open(f"{base}/{route}/rows/summary.json"))
    print(route, "stopped_reason", summary.get("stopped_reason"), "rows", len(rows))
    assert summary.get("stopped_reason") is not None or (len(rows) == reps and all(len(r["turns"]) == turns for r in rows))
    values = [float(t["turn_elapsed_s"]) for _, t in e._turns(rows) if e._narration_attempts(t) == 1 and t.get("error") is None]
    print(route, "clause 6 turns n=%d p50=%s p95=%s max=%s" % (len(values), e._nearest_rank(values, .5), e._nearest_rank(values, .95), max(values)))
jev = []; nar = []
for line in open(base + "/worker.log"):
    m = re.match(r"\S+ (/\S*) (\d+) (\d+)ms", line)
    if m and m.group(1) != "/__spent":
        (nar if m.group(1) == "/" else jev).append(int(m.group(3)))
for name, v in (("jev", jev), ("narration", nar)):
    v.sort(); print(name, "n", len(v), "p50", v[len(v)//2], "p95", v[max(0, int(len(v)*.95)-1)], "max", v[-1])
PY

PY
